title: kioku.tool.v1 build state
description: What THIS build implements, as opposed to what the contract names. Build state, not contract text: the schema files are frozen per major version, this file changes every phase. Keeping them apart is why the frozen files' digests stay stable.

rules.absent_means_implemented: A property with no entry here is implemented: it is published to the model and accepted.
rules.false_means_pruned: A property listed false is removed from the published schema and from its required list, and supplying it is refused with kioku.unsupported_operation and details.reason='not_implemented_in_this_build'. It is never silently dropped: a caller must not believe an override, a link or an attempt record was stored when nothing was.
rules.core_route: false means the Rails core has no route for this tool yet. The host still publishes the tool - the surface stays at six - and reports the core's absence honestly with kioku.source_unavailable rather than pretending the call succeeded.
rules.flipping_an_entry: Flipping an entry to true is the gate for the phase that implements it. The conformance suite then requires a tool input case exercising that property to pass end to end, so a flip with no implementation behind it fails.

notes.memory_key: Implemented. Context::Services::Memories::Remember already takes it and pairs it with expected_revision; the host's PERMITTED list was what made it unreachable.
notes.mandatory: Implemented. Remember refuses it for a non-user actor with kioku.authority_violation.
notes.override: The project-exception variant CLAUDE.md's first implementation slice needs - a shared preference plus one project exception. There is no project override row yet, so it stays false and the slice's phase flips it.
